2023-4518-6006-6633.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

261-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

728-2178-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
728-2178-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7768.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-5256-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-5256-7936.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

833-1059-3827-3861.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3827-3861.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Orzhov Basilica, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4478-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2043-7060-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-7060-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1895-3188-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-3188-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1621-2350-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

813-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
813-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
813-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

849-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-1376-5434.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-5434.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
206-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

903-2199-6035.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
903-2199-6035.notablePrerequisites:
Karplusan Minotaur has indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
Your life total is 5 or less.
903-2199-6035.description:
Cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}.
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Courageous Resolve, and Karplusan Minotaur cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 3.

1623-6614.notablePrerequisites: You have a spell in hand you can cast for only colorless mana.
1623-6614.description:
Cast any spell using only colorless mana.
Vexing Bauble triggers, exiling the spell and casting it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2034-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
222-527-2034-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

618-3580-5334.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2033-3430.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1978-2033-3430.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

3951-4094-5703-5929.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4094-5703-5929.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

204-1858-2056-2633-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-6633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

1995-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least four.
1995-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

2608-3151-4499.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Archdruid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three Elves.
2608-3151-4499.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk

2665-4377-5913.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3558-4875-5852.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
3558-4875-5852.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crookshank Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crookshank Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

618-2178-2584.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a nonlegendary creature whose base power is equal to or greater than its toughness.
618-2178-2584.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature whose base power is equal to or greater than its toughness with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to the creature token's power to the creature token.
The creature token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1839-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1839-2498-4691.description:
Activate Kuro by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Kuro abilities, giving a creature -1/-1 until end of turn for each ability.

654-864-1541-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Eternal Witness on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness's power.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Eternal Witness from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Eternal Witness and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Eternal Witness triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

2358-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
2358-4567.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

3140-4442.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Willbreaker triggers, causing you to gain control of that creature for as long as you control Willbreaker.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

541-544-1367-3634.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by tapping it and paying {2}, returning Venser from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

292-1495-3062.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-3062.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.
